answer: Clone crews fail a slack-water gate they cannot pre-time. The applicant bonds 7.80 POA and may lift sluice 4 on the east lagoon only after the public staff prints a 13-byte high-water hash at the published tide turn. A warden clips a sparrow-ring tag to the gate log and inks that hash plus two later staff cuts, 70 seconds apart, onto the tag. Auditors recompute the three cuts from the tide tape and refuse a second ring on sluice 4. Cost: 7.80 POA plus one slack-water watch. A pre-clipped tag, a forged staff, or a missed turn burns 47% and idles sluice 4 for five epochs.
